# The executor prompt does not say that a PR body carries no "Generated by" footer
- where: `docs/backlog/prompts/executor.md` (step 1.11: PR body written with `gh api ... -F body=@/tmp/pr.md`); see also `docs/backlog/tech-debt/2026-11-25-WR-002-1.md`
- why it matters: the cloud harness appends the footer, which CLAUDE.md forbids; every task PR so far (#8, #9, #12) lost a fix round to it. The prompt should require setting the body through the GitHub MCP `update_pull_request` tool (which leaves it clean) and reading it back
